context: Add a lint rule for absolute-path only_modify/do_not_modify globs; either normalize them to repo-relative at check-scope time or reject at create time. Extend the existing unsatisfiable-rung lint to flag tests applied to string literals.
description: skill-sync-untracked-config-provenance shipped with two unsatisfiable guardrails. (1) scope only_modify='/Users/joe/.skill-sync/**' is absolute, but check-scope matches 'git diff --name-only', which emits repo-relative paths; proven that even skills/code/SKILL.md reports 'outside only_modify allowlist', so no file can pass. (2) verification rung 1 was sh -c 'test -z "?? skills/skill-sync.config.yaml"', applying test -z to a non-empty literal, so it always exits 1 regardless of repo state - the class PR #1322 added lint for. Both fields are create-time-only, so the original id could not be repaired. Fix forward: teach todo lint to reject absolute-path scope globs for repos whose diffs are relative (or normalize absolute globs against the repo root at check-scope time), and extend the #1322 rung lint to catch constant-truth/constant-false shell tests.

preserves.behavior: Existing scope semantics for correctly-authored relative globs

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check src/todo_db/tracker.py tests/test_tracker.py
verifications.description: Canonical lint implementation remains formatted and clean

work_units.evidence: Absolute POSIX, Windows, and tilde scope globs are non-portable because changed paths are repository-relative. Constant test lint is limited to test/[ with unary -z/-n and a statically quoted or safe bare operand; variables, command substitutions, globs, and other test operators are excluded.
work_units.summary: Define portable absolute-scope and constant-shell-test lint boundaries

work_units.evidence: TodoTracker.lint now reports POSIX, Windows-drive, and home-relative scope globs plus provably static unary -z/-n shell assertions, while leaving dynamic shell and non-unary file tests untouched.
work_units.summary: Implement canonical todo-db lint findings for both invalid forms

work_units.evidence: 19 focused tests pass, including three nonportable scope forms, three constant shell-test forms, and four dynamic/nonconstant negative controls.
work_units.summary: Add positive and negative controls for POSIX, Windows, literal, and dynamic forms
